seo.title: Japanese Izakaya in Houston, TX
seo.description: Izakaya WA is Houston's first and only Japanese-owned and operated izakaya. Traditional small plates, sushi, robata-grilled skewers and sake, served in the spirit of wa — harmony.

hero.title: Houston's first and only Japanese-owned izakaya.
hero.intro: Traditional small plates, sushi, robata-grilled skewers and sake — served in the spirit of 和, harmony.

image.alt: A generous platter of assorted sushi arranged on a dark tray

philosophy.title: — wa, meaning harmony
body: In Japan, an izakaya is a neighborhood place to drink, eat and linger — a table that keeps filling up as the evening goes on. It is casual by design and generous by nature.

Izakaya WA is Houston's first and only Japanese-owned and operated izakaya, founded by Akira Asano and Hajime Kubokawa. Everything here is built around wa: the balance of small plates shared among friends, the rhythm of the grill, and a glass of sake poured to match.

Close-up of freshly made nigiri sushi

signature.title: A few of our signatures
signature.intro: The menu changes with the seasons and the day's catch. These are the plates our guests come back for.

experience.title: Eat, drink, and take your time
experience.intro: An izakaya is built for sharing. Order a few plates, pass them around, and let the table fill up.

items.title: Sushi & Sashimi
items.copy: Cut to order by our sushi chefs, with fish chosen for the day's board.

image.alt: Slices of sashimi plated with a dipping sauce

items.title: Robata & Yakitori
items.copy: Skewers and grilled plates cooked over the fire. Ask what's on the grill tonight.

image.alt: The counter of a small yakitori shop

items.title: Sake & Shochu
items.copy: The drinks matter as much as the food — sake flights, highballs and Japanese whisky.

image.alt: Bottles of sake lined up on a shelf

locations.title: Two Houston dining rooms
locations.intro: The same kitchen and the same spirit, at Memorial and River Oaks. Walk-ins are welcome; reservations are taken by phone.

cta.title: Join us for dinner tonight
